timecoded_text_to_speech.text: This is a pioneer in human and AI machine collaboration to create art and insight on how the biological and the mechanical coexist.
My name is Sukun Chang, I'm an artist and researcher working with robotics AI systems VR, using the AI system as a type of collaborator to change the way I draw and change the way I build.

That's been a really exciting and vital part of my exploration with these technologies, really understanding that you can dive in and work with the tools yourself and break them apart and put them back together.
It's a really exciting thing about the field right now. I think I'm always finding new ways to think about what the machine is by different data inputs and different data sources for it.
What I really like about the talks at the Museum of the Future is they give me an opportunity to pause my day-to-day and think about how changes in tech affect humans and business.

youtube_description:
This is a pioneer in human and AI-machine collaboration to create art and insight into how the biological and the mechanical coexist.

Sougwen Chung is an artist and researcher working with robotics, AI systems, VR... She encourages others to discover their own interpretations of machines.

What I like about The Museum of the Future is that it allows me to pause my day to day and think about how changes in tech can affect humans and business.
